title: Reactivated Service Level: Ranking and Level Drops
content:
**Ship-To Fulfillment Account — the service level a suspended ship-to comes back at.**

1. A suspended ship-to takes no orders and is reactivated by the agent at the customer's request, provided the customer's Commercial Credit Account status is active, at its prior service level lowered by the level drops its reactivation carries, never below Corbett Parcel Ship-To.
2. The prior service level is the level the suspended ship-to holds, and a reactivation that carries no level drop restores that level.
3. The service levels rank from lowest to highest Corbett Parcel Ship-To, Corbett Standard Ship-To, Corbett Priority Ship-To, Corbett Route Delivery Ship-To, Corbett Premier Route Ship-To and Corbett Dedicated Delivery Ship-To, and each level drop moves the reactivated level one place down that ranking.
4. Every level drop a reactivation carries is added and every drop taken back is subtracted, all in one total taken as never below zero; any adjustment made to the total itself is made to that net total, and the adjusted total is the number of places the ship-to comes back below its prior level.

### The ranking

| Place | Service level |
|---|---|
| 6 (highest) | Corbett Dedicated Delivery Ship-To |
| 5 | Corbett Premier Route Ship-To |
| 4 | Corbett Route Delivery Ship-To |
| 3 | Corbett Priority Ship-To |
| 2 | Corbett Standard Ship-To |
| 1 (lowest) | Corbett Parcel Ship-To |

### Worked cases (hypothetical)

| Prior level | Number of places down | Reactivated level |
|---|---|---|
| Corbett Premier Route Ship-To | 0 | Corbett Premier Route Ship-To |
| Corbett Premier Route Ship-To | 2 | Corbett Priority Ship-To |
| Corbett Standard Ship-To | 3 | Corbett Parcel Ship-To (never below the lowest level) |

*Netting, hypothetical:* three drops carried and one drop taken back give a net total of 2; one drop carried and two taken back give a net total of 0, never below zero, and the prior level is restored.
